Think Book Power Bank With Diary – Premium Corporate Gifting Solution

The Think Book Power Bank With Diary is a smart, premium, and multifunctional corporate gifting product designed for modern professionals, students, and executives. Combining a high-capacity power bank, elegant diary, and multiple utility accessories, this product delivers unmatched value, style, and daily usability. It is an ideal choice for corporate gifts, promotional giveaways, business conferences, employee onboarding kits, and executive gifting.

Crafted with a professional book-style design, the seamlessly integrates a 10000mAh power bank, study lamp, metal pendrive, and card storage into one compact unit. This makes it a highly demanded customized corporate gift that enhances brand recall and everyday convenience.

Equipped with a powerful 10000mAh battery capacity, this premium ensures reliable charging for smartphones, tablets, and other digital devices. It supports Input DC 5V 2A and Output DC 5V 2A, providing stable and efficient charging performance. The product is fully compatible with iOS, Android, and Type-C devices, making it a universal charging solution for today’s fast-paced lifestyle. The integrated LED logo option enhances branding visibility, making this product a top choice for companies looking for and high-end promotional items.

All-in-One Smart Utility Design

Designed for maximum functionality, the includes carefully curated features that professionals need every day. The premium flap closure ensures safety and elegance, while the book-style format adds a sophisticated corporate appeal.

  • Metal Pen with Dedicated Pen Loop
  • Study Lamp for Reading & Night Use
  • Metal Pendrive – 16GB Storage Capacity
  • Cash Pocket & Card Holder for Convenience
  • Flap Closure for Secure & Stylish Finish
  • Supports iOS, Android & Type-C Charging Cables

Premium Metal Accessories for a Professional Look

This product comes with a metal pen that enhances the executive feel and ensures smooth writing. The pen loop keeps it securely in place, making it perfect for meetings, conferences, and daily office use. Additionally, the 16GB metal pendrive offers reliable data storage for documents, presentations, and marketing materials, making it a valuable tool for professionals and students alike.

Perfect for Corporate & Promotional Gifting

The is widely used as a corporate gift in India due to its premium appearance and multi-utility design. It is suitable for bulk gifting during festive seasons, product launches, exhibitions, trade shows, and employee reward programs. With customization options like logo printing, LED logo branding, and personalized packaging, it helps businesses create a lasting impression.

Companies looking for promotional diaries, executive gift sets, and customized office accessories will find this product to be a high-ROI marketing solution.

Why Choose?

  • Premium all-in-one corporate gift solution
  • High-capacity 10000mAh
  • Elegant diary with smart utility features
  • Ideal for branding, promotions & executive gifting
  • Suitable for bulk corporate orders

If you are searching for a that blends technology, utility, and branding, the is the perfect choice. It reflects professionalism, innovation, and thoughtful gifting – all in one compact product.
